notes: DiscoFlate v3.49.1 — the Capacity Gauge's automatic colour now ramps green → TRUE YELLOW → red. It used to interpolate raw RGB, which made the midpoint a muddy olive; it now rotates the hue instead, so 50% is a real yellow. The virtual camera, the Stage page and the designer preview are byte-identical across the whole range. Setting an explicit Fill colour still overrides the ramp.
